name: negate_cannot_target_a_creature_spell
notes: P0e39720e5e G4. Printed: 'Counter target noncreature spell.' Seat 0 casts Walking Corpse (a creature spell). Seat 1 holds Negate and Convolute with {2}{U}: the response window offers only Convolute (which may target any spell), never Negate, whose only legal targets are noncreature spells. Seat 1 passes, the Corpse resolves, Negate stays in hand. Converted 2026-11-11 to real priority (docs/DESIGN_PRIORITY.md): the response window and its audit lanes are gone; nobody responds here.
